name: medicine ball supine chest throw
description: An explosive chest throw with a medicine ball while lying on your back. Develops fast pressing power in the triceps and chest.
instructions: Lie on your back on the floor with knees bent and feet planted.
Hold a suitable medicine ball with both hands at your chest, elbows close to your body.
Press explosively and throw the ball straight upward.
Catch it with both hands and soften your elbows as you bring it back to your chest, then repeat.
